depiction.primary_object: downward-pointing chevron enclosed inside a thick circle

readings.meaning: expand / dropdown / scroll down UI control

ambiguity: At small sizes in a to-do list, a circled downward chevron looks very similar to a circled checkmark (completed task) or a download arrow.

reasoning: The icon is a circled downward chevron—pure interface chrome used for dropdowns, expanding sections, or scrolling. In a to-do list it has no concrete subject, is easily confused with a circled checkmark at small sizes, and is inferior to a proper arrow-to-tray icon for download tasks.
